headline: Isak's quickfire double gives Iraola first Reds win
description: Alexander Isak was the star for Liverpool in their 2-0 win over Ipswich Town, scoring a three minute brace after just nine minutes of play giving Andoni Iraola his first win as Liverpool manager.

headline: Alexander Isak kickstarts Liverpool career after 'difficult' start
description: Alexander Isak said his difficult start to his Liverpool career is now behind him after he scored a brace inside nine minutes to inspire his side to a 2-0 win at Ipswich on Friday.
